entities.name: Constitutional Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Constitutional Revolution, a transformative movement in Iran (1794–1906). Emerged from Nadir Shah sacks Delhi and seizes the Peacock Throne and Koh-i-Noor diamond and Afsharid. Catalyzed Qajar and Treaties of Gulistan (1813) and Turkmenchay (1828) cede the Caucasus to Russia.
